ts
import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import SearchApplication from '../templates/search/SearchApplication.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/safe', component: defineComponent({ render: () => h('p', '安全返回页') }) }
		]
	});
	const app = createApp(SearchApplication);
	if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	app.mount(element);
	return () => app.unmount();
}

	<div class="card-geometry-controls" data-card-geometry>
		<label
			>{{ t('layout') }}
			<AsamSelect
				:model-value="modelValue.layout"
				:disabled="disabled"
				:size="size"
				@update:model-value="setLayout"
				><AsamOption value="grid" :label="t('grid')" /><AsamOption

			<AsamInputNumber

				:disabled="disabled"

				:min="1"

				@update:model-value="setColumns" /></label
		><label

				:disabled="disabled"

		/></label>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardPreset, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { CardPresentation } from './Presentation.js';
import { cardGeometryMessages } from './messages.js';
import type { CardGeometryLabel } from './messages.js';

const props = defineProps<{
	modelValue: CardPresentation;
	disabled?: boolean;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: CardPresentation] }>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n(cardGeometryMessages);
const t = (name: CardGeometryLabel) => i18n.t(`app.templates.cards.${name}`);
const presets = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large', 'custom'] as const;
const preset = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? 'custom' : props.modelValue.cardSize
);
const customMinWidth = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize.minWidth : 240
);
function update(value: Partial<CardPresentation>) {
	if (!props.disabled) emit('update:modelValue', { ...props.modelValue, ...value });
}
function setLayout(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'grid' || value === 'masonry') update({ layout: value });
}
function setPreset(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'custom')
		update({
			cardSize: {
				minWidth: 260,
				padding: 20,
				titleFontSize: 18,
				bodyFontSize: 14,
				contentGap: 12
			}
		});
	else if (presets.some((item) => item === value)) update({ cardSize: value as AsamCardPreset });
}
function setMinWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({
			cardSize: {
				...(typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize : {}),
				minWidth: value
			}
		});
}
function setColumns(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ columns: 'auto' });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0)
		update({ columns: value });
}
function setMaxWidth(value: unknown) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ maxWidth: undefined });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({ maxWidth: value });
}
</script>

import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { AriaAttributes } from 'vue';

// Vue透传的标准ARIA与本预览专用DOM事件；不放宽未知业务属性或事件。
declare module 'vue' {
	interface ComponentCustomProps {
		'aria-label'?: string;
		'aria-current'?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'];
	}
	interface HTMLAttributes {
		onAsamPreviewTheme?: (event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) => void;
	}
}

/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel<Value extends string | number>(
	read: () => Value,
	write: (value: Value) => void,
	choices: readonly Value[]
) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value as Value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read: () => boolean, write: (value: boolean) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read: () => string, write: (value: string) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

/** 模板展示配置；仅透传公开几何属性，不保存业务数据或控件 size。 */
export interface CardPresentation {
	readonly layout: AsamCardLayout;
	readonly cardSize: AsamCardSize;
	readonly columns: 'auto' | number;
	readonly maxWidth?: number;
}

export const createCardPresentation = (cardSize: AsamCardSize = 'default'): CardPresentation => ({
	layout: 'grid',
	cardSize,
	columns: 'auto'
});

const en = {

};
const zh = {
	layout: '布局',
	grid: '网格',
	masonry: '瀑布流',
	cardSize: '卡片密度',
	small: '紧凑',
	default: '默认',
	big: '宽松',
	large: '大卡片',
	custom: '自定义',
	minWidth: '最小宽度',
	columns: '列数',
	auto: '自动',
	maxWidth: '最大宽度',
	unlimited: '不限制'
};
export type CardGeometryLabel = keyof typeof en;
type CardGeometryParameters = {
	[K in CardGeometryLabel as `app.templates.cards.${K}`]: Record<never, never>;
};
declare module '@asam-ui/ui/i18n' {
	interface AsamI18nMessageParameters extends CardGeometryParameters {}
}
const prefix = (values: typeof en) =>
	Object.fromEntries(
		Object.entries(values).map(([key, value]) => ['app.templates.cards.' + key, value])
	) as { [K in keyof CardGeometryParameters]: string };
export const cardGeometryMessages = { en: prefix(en), 'zh-CN': prefix(zh) };

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord } from './Types.js';

export function displayValue(value: unknown, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return value === undefined
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided')
			: '未提供'
		: value === null
			? scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknown')
				: '未知'
			: value === false
				? scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.search.no')
					: '否'
				: value === true
					? scope?.enabled.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.search.yes')
						: '是'
					: String(value);
}
export function displayDate(value: string | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return displayValue(value, scope);
	return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) &&
		Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) &&
		new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					year: 'numeric',
					month: '2-digit',
					day: '2-digit',
					timeZone: 'UTC'
				}).format(new Date(value))
			: value
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.invalidDate')
			: '日期无效';
}
export function displayProgress(value: number | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.NumberFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					style: 'percent',
					maximumFractionDigits: 20
				}).format(value / 100)
			: `${value}%`
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknownProgress')
			: '进度未知';
}
/** 纯映射；从不写入行、读取权限、发起请求或改变导航。 */
export function searchContent(row: SearchRecord, scope?: AsamI18n): AsamListContent {
	const meta = [
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.category') : '类别',
			value: displayValue(row.category, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.status') : '状态',
			value: displayValue(row.status, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.owner') : '负责人',
			value: displayValue(row.owner, scope)
		}
	];
	if (row.kind === 'basic')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.reference') : '编号',
				value: row.reference
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.updated') : '更新',
				value: displayDate(row.updatedAt, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'cards')
		meta.push({
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.collection') : '合集',
			value: row.collection
		});
	if (row.kind === 'articles')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.author') : '作者',
				value: row.author
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.published') : '发布',
				value: displayDate(row.publishedAt, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.tags') : '标签',
				value:
					row.tags.join(' · ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.noTags') : '无标签')
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'projects')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.stage') : '阶段',
				value: displayValue(row.stage, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.progress') : '进度',
				value: displayProgress(row.progress, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.start') : '开始',
				value: displayDate(row.startDate, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.end') : '结束',
				value: displayDate(row.endDate, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'applications')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.version') : '版本',
				value: displayValue(row.version, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.platforms') : '平台',
				value:
					row.platforms.join(' / ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided') : '未提供')
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.available') : '可用',
				value: displayValue(row.available, scope)
			}
		);
	return {
		title: row.title,
		description: row.description,
		meta,
		...(row.kind === 'cards' ? { cover: row.cover } : {}),
		...(row.kind === 'projects'
			? {
					avatars: row.members.map((member, index) => ({
						id: `${index}`,
						name: member.name,
						src: member.avatar
					}))
				}
			: {})
	};
}

ts
import { computed } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListActionResult,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession } from './Types.js';

type QueryAction = AsamListController<SearchRecord>['submit'];

export function createSearchQueryController(
	session: SearchSession,
	view: {
		fields: () => readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
		encode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		decode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		reset?: QueryAction;
		beforeRead?: () => void;
	}
): AsamListController<SearchRecord> {
	const controller = session.controller;
	const ready = computed(
		() =>
			!session.access().disabled && session.access().permitted && controller.scopeReady.value
	);
	function guarded(action: QueryAction): QueryAction {
		return async (validate) => {
			if (!ready.value) return { status: 'blocked' };
			let result: AsamListActionResult = { status: 'blocked' };
			const current = await session.read(async () => {
				view.beforeRead?.();
				result = await action(validate);
			});
			return current ? result : { status: 'cancelled' };
		};
	}
	return {
		...controller,
		fields: computed(view.fields),
		draft: computed(() => view.encode?.(controller.draft.value) ?? controller.draft.value),
		scopeReady: ready,
		setDraft(draft) {
			if (ready.value) controller.setDraft(view.decode?.(draft) ?? draft);
		},
		submit: guarded(controller.submit),
		reset: guarded(view.reset ?? controller.reset)
	};
}

export function keywordQueryField(
	label: string,
	name: string,
	placeholder?: string
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name, placeholder, clearable: true } } }
	};
}

.search-application button:not([class*='el-']),
.search-application select:not([class*='el-']),
.search-application input:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
}
.search-application select:not([class*='el-']) {
	border: 1px solid var(--search-line);
	background: var(--search-surface);
	color: var(--search-ink);
	border-radius: 4px;
	min-height: 32px;
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.search-application :focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.search-page {
	max-width: 1440px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 36px;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.search-core {
	max-width: var(--template-list-max-width, 1120px);
	margin-inline: auto;
}
.search-page h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 48px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 12px 0 20px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}
.search-page h2 {
	font-size: 20px;
}
.search-page p {
	max-width: 75ch;
}
.search-eyebrow {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
	font-size: 12px;
	letter-spacing: 0.14em;
	color: var(--search-muted);
}

.search-draft {
	border-left: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	padding-left: 12px;
}
.search-record-key {
	color: var(--search-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
}
.search-results {
	margin-top: var(--asam-space-md, 12px);
	background: var(--search-canvas);
}
.search-append-target {
	min-height: 1px;
	text-align: center;
}
.search-record {
	min-width: 0;
}
.search-record-key {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
}
.search-app-icon {
	width: 64px;
	height: 64px;
	object-fit: cover;
	border-radius: 10px;
}
.search-progress {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 6px;
}
.search-progress progress {
	max-width: 100%;
	width: 100%;
	accent-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.search-family-minimal {
	background: var(--search-surface);
	max-width: 1120px;
	padding-top: 52px;
}
.search-family-minimal h1 {
	font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
	font-weight: 500;
}
.search-family-brand {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 36px;
}
.search-brand-rail {
	padding: 32px 24px;
	background: var(--asam-semantic-brand-surface);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
	align-self: start;
	min-height: 460px;
}
.search-brand-rail .search-eyebrow {
	color: inherit;
}
.search-brand-rail strong {
	display: block;
	font-size: 42px;
	line-height: 1.1;
	margin-block: 36px;
}
.search-brand-mark {
	width: 88px;
	height: 88px;
	border: 1px solid currentColor;
	display: grid;
	place-content: center;
	transform: rotate(-8deg);
}
.search-family-brand .search-brand-main {
	min-width: 0;
}
.search-family-technology {
	position: relative;
	background-image:
		linear-gradient(
			90deg,
			transparent 47px,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--search-line) 25%, transparent) 48px
		),
		linear-gradient(
			transparent 47px,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--search-line) 25%, transparent) 48px
		);
	background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.search-family-technology .search-core {
	background: var(--search-surface);
	padding: 24px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.search-family-technology h1 {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 42px);
}
.search-preview {
	margin: 24px auto;
	max-width: 920px;
	padding: 36px;
	background: var(--search-surface);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.search-preview h1 {
	line-height: 1.3;
}
.search-preview dl {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(80px, 1fr) minmax(0, 3fr);
	gap: 12px;
}
.search-preview dd {
	margin: 0;
}
.search-preview img {
	max-width: 100%;
}
.search-preview p {
	white-space: pre-wrap;
}
@keyframes search-arrive {
	from {
		opacity: 0.6;
		transform: translateY(5px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
.search-page {
	animation: search-arrive 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.search-page {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.search-family-brand {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
		gap: 20px;
	}
	.search-brand-rail {
		min-height: auto;
		padding: 20px;
	}
	.search-brand-rail strong {
		font-size: 28px;
		margin: 12px 0;
	}
	.search-brand-mark {
		display: none;
	}

	.search-family-technology .search-core {
		padding: 16px;
	}
	.search-preview {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.search-global {
		padding: 12px 16px;
	}
	.search-tabs {
		padding: 12px 16px;
	}
	.search-preview dl {
		grid-template-columns: 80px minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.search-page {
		animation: none;
	}
	.search-application *,
	.search-application *::before,
	.search-application *::after {
		animation-duration: 0s !important;
		transition-duration: 0s !important;
		scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	}
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { useSearchI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useSearchI18n();

import { createNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';

import type { NavigationTab } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import { searchPages } from './Pages.js';
import { choiceModel, booleanModel } from '../cards/Models.js';
import SearchPreview from './SearchPreview.vue';
import { createSearchSession } from './Session.js';
import { createSearchService } from './Service.js';
import { emptyConditions, encodeRowKey, searchKinds, displaySearchTitle } from './Types.js';
import type {
	SearchFamily,
	SearchKind,
	SearchRecord,
	SearchAccess,
	ApplicationRecord
} from './Types.js';

const props = defineProps<{ confirm?: () => boolean | Promise<boolean> }>();
const router = useRouter(); // 借入router，不dispose。
const applicationRoot = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
let viewRun = 0;
type MutableSearchAccess = { -readonly [Key in keyof SearchAccess]: SearchAccess[Key] };
const access = reactive<MutableSearchAccess>({
	identity: 'synthetic-reader',
	version: '1',
	disabled: false,
	readonly: false,
	permitted: true
} satisfies SearchAccess);
const initialFamily =
	typeof window === 'undefined'
		? null
		: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('family');
const familyState = shallowRef<SearchFamily>(
	initialFamily === 'brand' || initialFamily === 'technology' ? initialFamily : 'minimal'
);
const family = choiceModel(
	() => familyState.value,
	(value) => {
		familyState.value = value;
	},
	['minimal', 'brand', 'technology']
);
const sizeState = shallowRef<AsamControlSize>('default');
const size = choiceModel(
	() => sizeState.value,
	(value) => {
		sizeState.value = value;
	},
	['large', 'big', 'default', 'small']
);
const darkState = shallowRef(family.value === 'technology'),
	ready = shallowRef(false),
	feedback = shallowRef('');
const dark = booleanModel(
	() => darkState.value,
	(value) => {
		darkState.value = value;
	}
);
const accessReadonly = booleanModel(
	() => access.readonly,
	(value) => {
		access.readonly = value;
	}
);
const accessDisabled = booleanModel(
	() => access.disabled,
	(value) => {
		access.disabled = value;
	}
);
const accessPermitted = booleanModel(
	() => access.permitted,
	(value) => {
		access.permitted = value;
	}
);
const sizeLabel = (value: AsamControlSize) => {
	const keys = {
		large: 'app.templates.search.sizelarge',
		big: 'app.templates.search.sizebig',
		default: 'app.templates.search.sizedefault',
		small: 'app.templates.search.sizesmall'
	} as const;
	return i18n.t(keys[value]);
};
const sizes: readonly AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const initialKind =
	typeof window === 'undefined'
		? 'basic'
		: (searchKinds.find(
				(value) => value === new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('kind')
			) ?? 'basic');
const navigation = shallowRef<NavigationController>();
const services = Object.fromEntries(
	searchKinds.map((kind) => [kind, createSearchService(kind)])
) as Record<SearchKind, ReturnType<typeof createSearchService>>;
const sessions = Object.fromEntries(
	searchKinds.map((kind) => [
		kind,
		createSearchSession({
			kind,
			service: services[kind],
			access: () => access,
			accumulatePages: true

	])
) as Record<SearchKind, ReturnType<typeof createSearchSession>>;
const routeKind = () => {
	const input = router.currentRoute.value.params.kind;
	return searchKinds.find((value) => value === input) ?? 'basic';

const kind = computed(routeKind),
	session = computed(() => sessions[kind.value]);
const blocked = computed(() => access.disabled || !access.permitted);
const previewing = computed(
	() =>

);
const opened = computed(() => router.currentRoute.value.path.startsWith('/application/'));
interface PageIdentity {
	tab: Readonly<NavigationTab>;
	cacheKey: string;
	epoch: number;
}
function currentPageIdentity(): PageIdentity | undefined {
	const tab = nav.tabs.value.find((item) => item.fullPath === router.currentRoute.value.fullPath);
	return tab ? { tab, cacheKey: tab.cacheKey, epoch: tab.epoch } : undefined;
}
function identityCurrent(identity: PageIdentity | undefined): boolean {
	return (
		!!identity &&
		nav.tabs.value.some((tab) => tab === identity.tab) &&
		identity.tab.cacheKey === identity.cacheKey &&
		identity.tab.epoch === identity.epoch

}
const selected = shallowRef<{
	row: SearchRecord;
	token: string;
	source: AsamListIntent;
	sourceRef: AsamListIntent;
	draft: AsamFieldModel;
	revision: number;
	origin: PageIdentity;
	target?: PageIdentity;
}>();
const validPreview = computed(() => {
	const snapshot = selected.value;
	return (
		!!snapshot &&
		snapshot.row.kind === kind.value &&
		router.currentRoute.value.params.key === encodeRowKey(snapshot.row.id) &&
		snapshot.revision === navigation.value?.revision.value &&
		identityCurrent(snapshot.origin) &&
		(!snapshot.target || identityCurrent(snapshot.target)) &&
		(!opened.value ||
			(snapshot.row.kind === 'applications' &&
				snapshot.row.available === true &&
				snapshot.row.route === 'local-demo')) &&
		session.value.controller.resultReady.value &&
		session.value.controller.successfulSource.value === snapshot.sourceRef &&
		session.value.current(snapshot.token)
	);
});
let alive = true,
	navigationToken = 0;
interface NavigationBoundary {
	run: number;
	owner: typeof session.value;
	token: string;
	revision: number;
	intent: AsamListIntent | null;
	draft: AsamFieldModel;
	source: AsamListIntent | null;
	result: boolean;
	readonlyMode: boolean;
	row?: SearchRecord;
	origin?: PageIdentity;
	target?: PageIdentity;
}

function boundaryCurrent(boundary: NavigationBoundary | undefined): boolean {
	if (!boundary) return true;
	const c = boundary.owner.controller;
	return (
		boundary.run === navigationToken &&
		boundary.owner.current(boundary.token) &&
		boundary.revision === nav.revision.value &&
		c.intent.value === boundary.intent &&
		c.draft.value === boundary.draft &&
		(!boundary.result ||
			(boundary.owner.access().readonly === boundary.readonlyMode &&
				identityCurrent(boundary.origin) &&
				(!boundary.target || identityCurrent(boundary.target)) &&
				c.resultReady.value &&

	);

	render: () =>

});
const nav = createNavigation({
	i18n,
	router,
	scope: access.identity,
	fallback: '/safe',
	components: { search: searchRoute, preview: SearchPreview, application: SearchPreview },
	load: async () => [
		{
			id: 'search',
			path: '/search/:kind',
			title: '搜索页面',
			resource: 'search',
			location: '/search/basic'
		},
		{
			id: 'preview',
			path: '/preview/:kind/:key',
			title: '本地内容预览',
			resource: 'preview',
			location: '/preview/basic/missing'
		},
		{
			id: 'application',
			path: '/application/:kind/:key',
			title: '本地应用演示',
			resource: 'application',
			location: '/application/applications/missing'
		}
	],
	confirm: async () => {
		const boundary = pendingNavigation;
		const owner = session.value,
			token = owner.guard(),
			revision = nav.revision.value;
		const intent = owner.controller.intent.value,
			draft = owner.controller.draft.value;
		if (!owner.current(token) || !boundaryCurrent(boundary)) return false;
		const accepted = await props.confirm?.();
		return (
			alive &&
			boundaryCurrent(boundary) &&
			accepted !== false &&
			owner === session.value &&
			owner.current(token) &&

			revision === nav.revision.value

// NavigationController确认后，宿主其他同步guard仍可能重入；最后阶段再核一次。
let guardSnapshot:
	| {
			owner: typeof session.value;
			token: string;
			revision: number;
			intent: AsamListIntent | null;
			draft: AsamFieldModel;
			boundary?: NavigationBoundary;
	  }
	| undefined;
const removeBefore = router.beforeEach(() => {
	guardSnapshot = {
		owner: session.value,
		token: session.value.guard(),
		intent: session.value.controller.intent.value,
		draft: session.value.controller.draft.value,
		boundary: pendingNavigation,
		revision: nav.revision.value
	};
	return !blocked.value;
});
const removeResolve = router.beforeResolve((to) => {
	const snapshot = guardSnapshot;
	const row = selected.value?.row;
	const applicationAllowed =
		!ready.value ||
		!to.path.startsWith('/application/') ||
		(validPreview.value &&
			row?.kind === 'applications' &&
			row.available === true &&
			row.route === 'local-demo' &&
			to.params.kind === row.kind &&
			to.params.key === encodeRowKey(row.id));
	return (
		applicationAllowed &&
		!!snapshot &&
		snapshot.owner.current(snapshot.token) &&
		boundaryCurrent(snapshot.boundary) &&
		snapshot.intent === snapshot.owner.controller.intent.value &&
		snapshot.draft === snapshot.owner.controller.draft.value &&
		snapshot.revision === nav.revision.value &&

	);
});
async function navigate(
	id: 'search' | 'preview' | 'application',
	targetKind: SearchKind,
	key?: string
) {
	const owner = session.value,
		token = owner.guard(),

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchKind, SearchRecord, SearchService } from './Types.js';
import { encodeRowKey } from './Types.js';

const categories = ['设计', '工程', 0, '0', null] as const;
const statuses = ['已就绪', '进行中', false, null] as const;
const owners = ['林岚', '周远', 0, '0', null, undefined] as const;
export const localGraphic = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="280" viewBox="0 0 600 280"><rect width="600" height="280" fill="#dde8e3"/><path d="M40 240L210 40 380 240ZM260 240L430 40 570 240Z" fill="none" stroke="#46675a" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="300" cy="140" r="62" fill="#a4c3b4"/></svg>')}`;
/** 合成数据固定100条；0与'0'拥有独立typed身份。 */
export function createSearchRecords(kind: SearchKind): SearchRecord[] {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index): SearchRecord => {
		const base = {
			id: index === 1 ? '0' : index === 0 ? 0 : index,
			title:
				index === 6
					? '跨团队协作中的设计约束、工程记录与长期内容整理方法'.repeat(3)
					: `${['山海知识', '城市观察', '协作档案', '开放研究'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
			description:
				index === 6
					? '长内容用于检验窄屏换行与完整阅读。'.repeat(9)
					: '记录设计、工程与协作中的具体方法，提供可追溯的本地演示内容。',
			category: categories[index % categories.length],
			status: statuses[index % statuses.length],
			owner: owners[index % owners.length]
		};
		switch (kind) {
			case 'basic':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					reference: `REF-${index + 1}`,
					updatedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-12' : undefined
				};
			case 'cards':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					cover: {
						src: index === 3 ? './missing-cover.svg' : localGraphic,
						alt: `山海几何构图 ${index + 1}`
					},
					collection: index % 2 ? '空间研究' : '日常设计'
				};
			case 'articles':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					author: index % 2 ? '陈澄' : '许知',
					publishedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-10' : null,
					tags: ['设计方法', index % 2 ? '案例' : '实践'],
					body: [
						'从一个具体问题开始，记录观察、约束与取舍。',
						'示例正文仅为本地合成文本。<script>不会执行</script>',
						base.description
					]
				};
			case 'projects':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					stage: index % 4 ? '宿主阶段：研究验证' : undefined,
					progress: index % 4 ? (index * 7) % 101 : NaN,
					startDate: '2026-09-01',
					endDate: index % 3 ? '2026-12-01' : null,
					members: [
						{ name: '林岚', avatar: index === 2 ? './missing-avatar.svg' : undefined },
						{ name: '周远' }
					]
				};
			case 'applications':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					icon: localGraphic,
					version: index % 3 ? '2.1.0' : null,
					platforms: ['Web', '桌面浏览器'],
					available: index % 3 ? true : false,
					route: 'local-demo'
				};
		}
	});
}
export function querySearchRecords(
	rows: readonly SearchRecord[],
	request: AsamListRequest
): { list: SearchRecord[]; total: number } {
	const q = request.query;
	const keyword = typeof q.keyword === 'string' ? q.keyword.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
	const filtered = rows.filter(
		(row) =>
			(!keyword ||
				`${row.title} ${row.description} ${row.kind === 'articles' ? row.body.join(' ') : ''}`
					.toLocaleLowerCase()
					.includes(keyword)) &&
			['category', 'status', 'owner'].every(
				(key) =>
					q[key] === undefined ||
					Object.is(
						key === 'status' && row.kind === 'applications'
							? row.available
							: Reflect.get(row, key),
						q[key]
					)
			)
	);
	if (request.sort) {
		const { field, order } = request.sort;
		if (!['title', 'id'].includes(field))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('未允许的排序字段'),
				'app.templates.search.invalidSort'
			);
		filtered.sort(
			(a, b) =>
				String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
					String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
					'zh-CN',
					{ numeric: true }
				) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1) ||
				encodeRowKey(a.id).localeCompare(encodeRowKey(b.id))
		);
	}
	return {
		list: filtered.slice(
			(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
			request.currentPage * request.pageSize
		),
		total: filtered.length
	};
}
/** 这是可替换的合成读取适配，查询/排序作用于全部100条。 */
export function createSearchService(
	kind: SearchKind
): SearchService & { failNext(): void; readonly calls: number } {
	const rows = createSearchRecords(kind);
	let fail = false,
		calls = 0;
	return {
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		failNext() {
			fail = true;
		},
		async read(request, context) {
			calls++;
			const shouldFail = fail;
			fail = false;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new DOMException('读取取消', 'AbortError'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 100);
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
				else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			});
			if (shouldFail)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'合成读取失败，请重试',
					'app.templates.search.readFailed'
				);
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
}
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { effectScope, toValue } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession, SearchSessionOptions } from './Types.js';
import { emptyConditions } from './Types.js';
import { searchContent } from './Content.js';

export const searchFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text', defaultValue: () => '' },
	...['category', 'status', 'owner'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: { category: '类别', status: '状态', owner: '负责人' }[key] ?? key,
		kind: 'single' as const,
		query: (value: unknown) => value
	}))
];
/** 自有effect scope只释放本会话创建的controller；借入runtime/controller从不dispose。 */
export function createSearchSession(options: SearchSessionOptions): SearchSession {
	if (options.controller && !options.runtime)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('借入controller必须显式提供其宿主runtime'),
			'app.templates.search.borrowRuntime'
		);
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const runtime =
		options.runtime ??
		createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: `search:${options.kind}:${toValue(options.access).identity}`
		});
	let alive = true;
	const access = () => toValue(options.access);
	const guard = () =>
		JSON.stringify([
			runtime.scope,
			runtime.epoch,
			access().identity,
			access().version,
			access().disabled,
			access().permitted
		]);
	const current = (token: string) =>
		alive && !access().disabled && access().permitted && token === guard();
	const accumulatesPages = !!options.accumulatePages && !options.controller;
	const prefixes = new Map<number, readonly SearchRecord[]>();
	const queryKey = (query: AsamListRequest) =>
		JSON.stringify([query.query, query.sort, query.pageSize]);
	const controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord> =
		options.controller ??
		scope.run(() =>
			useAsamListController<SearchRecord>({
				fields: searchFields,
				initial: { ...emptyConditions },
				pageSize: 20,
				immediate: false,
				rowKey: (row) => row.id,
				runtime,
				api: async (request, context) => {
					const token = guard();
					if (!current(token))
						throw createAsamMessageError(
							'当前身份、权限或禁用状态不允许读取',
							'app.templates.search.readDenied'
						);
					let prefix: readonly SearchRecord[] = [];
					if (accumulatesPages) {
						const previous = controller.successfulSource.value;
						if (request.currentPage === 1) prefixes.clear();
						else if (
							previous?.epoch === runtime.epoch &&
							queryKey(previous) === queryKey(request)
						) {
							if (previous.currentPage + 1 === request.currentPage) {
								prefix = controller.page.data.value.list;
								prefixes.set(request.currentPage, prefix);
							} else if (previous.currentPage >= request.currentPage) {
								prefix = prefixes.get(request.currentPage) ?? [];
							}
						}
					}
					const result = await options.service.read(request, context);
					context.signal.throwIfAborted();
					if (!current(token)) throw new DOMException('读取上下文已失效', 'AbortError');
					if (!accumulatesPages || !result.total) return result;
					const records = new Map(
						[...prefix, ...result.list].map((row) => [row.id, row])
					);
					return {
						list: [...records.values()].slice(0, result.total),
						total: result.total
					};
				}
			})
		)!;
	return {
		kind: options.kind,
		accumulatesPages,
		controller,
		runtime,
		content: searchContent,
		access,
		guard,
		current,
		async read(operation) {
			const token = guard();
			if (!current(token)) return false;
			await operation();
			return current(token);
		},
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			scope.stop();
		}
	};
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamRowKey, AsamControlSize, AsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest,
	AsamListContent,
	AsamListAction
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { MaybeRefOrGetter } from 'vue';

export type SearchKind = 'basic' | 'cards' | 'articles' | 'projects' | 'applications';
export type SearchFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology';
export interface SearchBase {
	readonly id: AsamRowKey;
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null;
	readonly status: string | boolean | null;
	readonly owner?: string | number | null;
}
export interface BasicRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'basic';
	readonly updatedAt?: string | null;
	readonly reference: string;
}
export interface CardRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'cards';
	readonly updatedAt?: string;
	readonly cover: { readonly src: string; readonly alt: string };
	readonly collection: string;
}
export interface ArticleRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'articles';
	readonly author: string;
	readonly publishedAt?: string | null;
	readonly tags: readonly string[];
	readonly body: readonly string[];
}
export interface ProjectRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'projects';
	readonly stage?: string | null;
	readonly progress?: number | null;
	readonly startDate?: string | null;
	readonly endDate?: string | null;
	readonly members: readonly { readonly name: string; readonly avatar?: string }[];
}
export interface ApplicationRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'applications';
	readonly icon: string;
	readonly version?: string | null;
	readonly platforms: readonly string[];
	/** 应用可用性；null表示未知，与通用行status独立。P14的status查询映射此字段。 */
	readonly available: boolean | null;
	readonly route: 'local-demo';
}
export type SearchRecord =
	BasicRecord | CardRecord | ArticleRecord | ProjectRecord | ApplicationRecord;
export interface SearchConditions {
	readonly keyword: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null | undefined;
	/** P14映射available：true可用、false不可用、null未知、undefined不限；其他页映射行status。 */
	readonly status: string | boolean | null | undefined;
	readonly owner: string | number | null | undefined;
}
export interface SearchService {
	read(
		request: AsamListRequest,
		context: { readonly signal: AbortSignal }
	): Promise<{ list: SearchRecord[]; total: number }>;
}
export interface SearchAccess {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly disabled: boolean;
	readonly readonly: boolean;
	readonly permitted: boolean;
}
export interface SearchSessionOptions {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly service: SearchService;
	readonly access: MaybeRefOrGetter<SearchAccess>;
	readonly runtime?: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly controller?: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	/** 读取下一批结果时保留已成功返回的前序页面。 */
	readonly accumulatePages?: boolean;
}
export interface SearchPageProps {
	readonly session: SearchSession;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	/** 宿主返回真实导航结果；事件仅在成功后通知，不作为异步操作回执。 */
	readonly navigatePreview: (row: SearchRecord) => Promise<boolean>;
	/** 独立页面可组合原操作；省略时沿用原只读预览入口。 */
	readonly rowActions?: readonly AsamListAction<SearchRecord>[];
}
export interface SearchSession {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly accumulatesPages?: boolean;
	readonly controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly content: (row: SearchRecord) => AsamListContent;
	access(): SearchAccess;
	guard(): string;
	current(token: string): boolean;
	read(operation: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
	dispose(): void;
}
export const searchKinds: readonly SearchKind[] = [
	'basic',
	'cards',
	'articles',
	'projects',
	'applications'
];
export const searchTitles: Readonly<Record<SearchKind, string>> = {
	basic: '资料列表',
	cards: '灵感卡片',
	articles: '文章搜索',
	projects: '项目搜索',
	applications: '应用搜索'
};
export const emptyConditions: SearchConditions = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined
};
export function encodeRowKey(key: AsamRowKey): string {
	return `${typeof key}:${String(key)}`;
}

export function displaySearchTitle(kind: SearchKind, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	const keys = {
		basic: 'app.templates.search.titleBasic',
		cards: 'app.templates.search.titleCards',
		articles: 'app.templates.search.titleArticles',
		projects: 'app.templates.search.titleProjects',
		applications: 'app.templates.search.titleApplications'
	} as const;
	return scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t(keys[kind]) : searchTitles[kind];
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Bottom, Refresh, Sort, Top } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from '../../shared/ListToolbarTypes.js';
import type { SearchSession } from '../Types.js';

const modes = [
	{ sort: null, label: 'defaultSort', icon: Sort },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'ascending' }, label: 'titleAsc', icon: Top },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'descending' }, label: 'titleDesc', icon: Bottom }
] as const;

type SortLabel = (typeof modes)[number]['label'];

export function useSearchListTools(
	session: SearchSession,
	sortLabel: (key: SortLabel) => string,
	refreshLabel: () => string,
	{ refreshFromStart = false } = {}
) {
	const c = session.controller;
	const canQuery = computed(() => {
		const access = session.access();
		return access.permitted && !access.disabled && c.scopeReady.value;
	});
	const canRead = computed(() => canQuery.value && !c.page.loading.value);
	const sortIndex = computed(() => {
		const sort = c.intent.value?.sort;
		return Math.max(
			0,
			modes.findIndex(
				({ sort: mode }) => mode?.field === sort?.field && mode?.order === sort?.order
			)
		);
	});
	const tools = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
		const mode = modes[sortIndex.value] ?? modes[0];
		return [
			{
				id: 'sort',
				label: sortLabel(mode.label),
				icon: mode.icon,
				disabled: !canQuery.value || !c.intent.value,
				ariaDisabled: canQuery.value && !canRead.value,
				pressed: sortIndex.value !== 0,
				state: sortIndex.value === 0 ? 'default-sort' : undefined
			},
			{ id: 'refresh', label: refreshLabel(), icon: Refresh, disabled: !canRead.value }
		];
	});
	function run(id: string) {
		if (!canRead.value) return;
		if (id === 'sort' && c.intent.value) {
			const next = modes[(sortIndex.value + 1) % modes.length] ?? modes[0];
			void session.read(() => c.setSort(next.sort));
		}
		if (id === 'refresh') {
			const intent = c.intent.value;
			void session.read(() =>
				refreshFromStart && intent && intent.currentPage > 1
					? c.setSort(intent.sort)
					: c.refresh()
			);
		}
	}
	return { tools, run };
}

		<div class="template-list-toolbar-start">
			<AsamButton
				v-if="createLabel"
				type="primary"
				:size="size"
				:icon="Plus"
				:disabled="createDisabled"
				@click="emit('create')"
				>{{ createLabel }}</AsamButton
			><span v-if="summary" class="template-list-toolbar-summary" role="status">{{
				summary
			}}</span>
		</div>
		<div v-if="actions.length" class="template-list-toolbar-tools">
			<AsamButton
				v-for="tool in actions"
				:key="tool.id"
				class="template-list-toolbar-icon"
				type="primary"
				:text="!tool.pressed"
				:size="size"
				:icon="tool.icon"
				:disabled="tool.disabled"
				:aria-disabled="tool.ariaDisabled || undefined"
				:aria-pressed="tool.pressed"
				:aria-label="tool.label"
				:title="tool.label"
				:data-state="tool.state"
				@click="activate(tool)"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from './ListToolbarTypes.js';

const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		label: string;
		summary?: string;
		size?: AsamControlSize;
		createLabel?: string;
		createDisabled?: boolean;
		tools?: readonly ListToolbarTool[];
		viewDisabled?: boolean;
		wide?: boolean;
		layout?: AsamCardLayout;
	}>(),
	{ wide: undefined }
);
const emit = defineEmits<{
	create: [];
	action: [id: string];
	'update:wide': [wide: boolean];
	'update:layout': [layout: AsamCardLayout];
}>();
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool: ListToolbarTool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import SearchApplication from '../templates/search/SearchApplication.vue';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/safe', component: defineComponent({ render: () => h('p', '安全返回页') }) }
		]
	});
	const app = createApp(SearchApplication);
	if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	app.mount(element);
	return () => app.unmount();
}

<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamInputNumber } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { cardGeometryMessages } from './messages.js';
const props = defineProps({
	modelValue: { type: Object, required: true },
	disabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['update:modelValue']);
const i18n = useAsamProI18n(cardGeometryMessages);
const t = (name) => i18n.t(`app.templates.cards.${name}`);
const presets = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large', 'custom'];
const preset = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? 'custom' : props.modelValue.cardSize
);
const customMinWidth = computed(() =>
	typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize.minWidth : 240
);
function update(value) {
	if (!props.disabled) emit('update:modelValue', { ...props.modelValue, ...value });
}
function setLayout(value) {
	if (value === 'grid' || value === 'masonry') update({ layout: value });
}
function setPreset(value) {
	if (value === 'custom')
		update({
			cardSize: {
				minWidth: 260,
				padding: 20,
				titleFontSize: 18,
				bodyFontSize: 14,
				contentGap: 12
			}
		});
	else if (presets.some((item) => item === value)) update({ cardSize: value });
}
function setMinWidth(value) {
	if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({
			cardSize: {
				...(typeof props.modelValue.cardSize === 'object' ? props.modelValue.cardSize : {}),
				minWidth: value
			}
		});
}
function setColumns(value) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ columns: 'auto' });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0)
		update({ columns: value });
}
function setMaxWidth(value) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) update({ maxWidth: undefined });
	else if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0)
		update({ maxWidth: value });
}
</script>

import { computed } from 'vue';
/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel(read, write, choices) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

export function displayValue(value, scope) {
	return value === undefined
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided')
			: '未提供'
		: value === null
			? scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknown')
				: '未知'
			: value === false
				? scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.search.no')
					: '否'
				: value === true
					? scope?.enabled.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.search.yes')
						: '是'
					: String(value);
}
export function displayDate(value, scope) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return displayValue(value, scope);
	return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) &&
		Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) &&
		new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					year: 'numeric',
					month: '2-digit',
					day: '2-digit',
					timeZone: 'UTC'
				}).format(new Date(value))
			: value
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.invalidDate')
			: '日期无效';
}
export function displayProgress(value, scope) {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.NumberFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					style: 'percent',
					maximumFractionDigits: 20
				}).format(value / 100)
			: `${value}%`
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknownProgress')
			: '进度未知';
}
/** 纯映射；从不写入行、读取权限、发起请求或改变导航。 */
export function searchContent(row, scope) {
	const meta = [
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.category') : '类别',
			value: displayValue(row.category, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.status') : '状态',
			value: displayValue(row.status, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.owner') : '负责人',
			value: displayValue(row.owner, scope)
		}
	];
	if (row.kind === 'basic')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.reference') : '编号',
				value: row.reference
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.updated') : '更新',
				value: displayDate(row.updatedAt, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'cards')
		meta.push({
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.collection') : '合集',
			value: row.collection
		});
	if (row.kind === 'articles')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.author') : '作者',
				value: row.author
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.published') : '发布',
				value: displayDate(row.publishedAt, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.tags') : '标签',
				value:
					row.tags.join(' · ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.noTags') : '无标签')
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'projects')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.stage') : '阶段',
				value: displayValue(row.stage, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.progress') : '进度',
				value: displayProgress(row.progress, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.start') : '开始',
				value: displayDate(row.startDate, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.end') : '结束',
				value: displayDate(row.endDate, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'applications')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.version') : '版本',
				value: displayValue(row.version, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.platforms') : '平台',
				value:
					row.platforms.join(' / ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided') : '未提供')
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.available') : '可用',
				value: displayValue(row.available, scope)
			}
		);
	return {
		title: row.title,
		description: row.description,
		meta,
		...(row.kind === 'cards' ? { cover: row.cover } : {}),
		...(row.kind === 'projects'
			? {
					avatars: row.members.map((member, index) => ({
						id: `${index}`,
						name: member.name,
						src: member.avatar
					}))
				}
			: {})
	};
}

import TechCards from './technology/CardListPage.vue';

export const searchPages = {

import { computed } from 'vue';
export function createSearchQueryController(session, view) {
	const controller = session.controller;
	const ready = computed(
		() =>
			!session.access().disabled && session.access().permitted && controller.scopeReady.value
	);
	function guarded(action) {
		return async (validate) => {
			if (!ready.value) return { status: 'blocked' };
			let result = { status: 'blocked' };
			const current = await session.read(async () => {
				view.beforeRead?.();
				result = await action(validate);
			});
			return current ? result : { status: 'cancelled' };
		};
	}
	return {
		...controller,
		fields: computed(view.fields),
		draft: computed(() => view.encode?.(controller.draft.value) ?? controller.draft.value),
		scopeReady: ready,
		setDraft(draft) {
			if (ready.value) controller.setDraft(view.decode?.(draft) ?? draft);
		},
		submit: guarded(controller.submit),
		reset: guarded(view.reset ?? controller.reset)
	};
}
export function keywordQueryField(label, name, placeholder) {
	return {
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name, placeholder, clearable: true } } }
	};
}

.search-application {
	--search-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f7f8fa);
	--search-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--search-ink: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #202a31);
	--search-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	--search-line: var(--asam-color-border, #cbd5d9);
	color: var(--search-ink);
	background: var(--search-canvas);
	min-height: 100%;
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	line-height: 1.65;
	--el-bg-color: var(--search-surface);
	--el-bg-color-overlay: var(--search-surface);
	--el-fill-color-blank: var(--search-surface);
	--el-text-color-primary: var(--search-ink);
	--el-text-color-regular: var(--search-ink);
	--el-text-color-secondary: var(--search-muted);
	--el-text-color-placeholder: var(--search-muted);
	--el-border-color: var(--search-line);
}
.search-application * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.search-application.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.search-global {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 12px;
	padding: 16px 24px;
	align-items: center;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--search-line);
}
.search-global label {
	display: flex;
	gap: 6px;
	align-items: center;
}
.search-global select:not([class*='el-']) {
	max-width: 180px;
}
.search-tabs {
	display: flex;
	gap: 8px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	padding: 12px 24px;
}
.search-application button:not([class*='el-']),
.search-application select:not([class*='el-']),
.search-application input:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
}
.search-application select:not([class*='el-']) {
	border: 1px solid var(--search-line);
	background: var(--search-surface);
	color: var(--search-ink);
	border-radius: 4px;
	min-height: 32px;
}
/* Date and time controls draw focus on their visible wrapper. */
.search-application :focus-visible:not(:where(.asam-date-time-control .el-input__wrapper > input)) {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.search-page {
	max-width: 1440px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 36px;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.search-core {
	max-width: var(--template-list-max-width, 1120px);
	margin-inline: auto;
}
.search-page h1 {
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 48px);
	line-height: 1.2;
	margin: 12px 0 20px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}
.search-page h2 {
	font-size: 20px;
}
.search-page p {
	max-width: 75ch;
}
.search-eyebrow {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
	font-size: 12px;
	letter-spacing: 0.14em;
	color: var(--search-muted);
}

.search-draft {
	border-left: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	padding-left: 12px;
}
.search-record-key {
	color: var(--search-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
}
.search-results {
	margin-top: var(--asam-space-md, 12px);
	background: var(--search-canvas);
}
.search-append-target {
	min-height: 1px;
	text-align: center;
}
.search-record {
	min-width: 0;
}
.search-record-key {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
}
.search-app-icon {
	width: 64px;
	height: 64px;
	object-fit: cover;
	border-radius: 10px;
}
.search-progress {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 6px;
}
.search-progress progress {
	max-width: 100%;
	width: 100%;
	accent-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.search-family-minimal {
	background: var(--search-surface);
	max-width: 1120px;
	padding-top: 52px;
}
.search-family-minimal h1 {
	font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, serif;
	font-weight: 500;
}
.search-family-brand {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: 36px;
}
.search-brand-rail {
	padding: 32px 24px;
	background: var(--asam-semantic-brand-surface);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-brand-foreground);
	align-self: start;
	min-height: 460px;
}
.search-brand-rail .search-eyebrow {
	color: inherit;
}
.search-brand-rail strong {
	display: block;
	font-size: 42px;
	line-height: 1.1;
	margin-block: 36px;
}
.search-brand-mark {
	width: 88px;
	height: 88px;
	border: 1px solid currentColor;
	display: grid;
	place-content: center;
	transform: rotate(-8deg);
}
.search-family-brand .search-brand-main {
	min-width: 0;
}
.search-family-technology {
	position: relative;
	background-image:
		linear-gradient(
			90deg,
			transparent 47px,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--search-line) 25%, transparent) 48px
		),
		linear-gradient(
			transparent 47px,
			color-mix(in srgb, var(--search-line) 25%, transparent) 48px
		);
	background-size: 48px 48px;
}
.search-family-technology .search-core {
	background: var(--search-surface);
	padding: 24px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.search-family-technology h1 {
	font-family: ui-monospace, monospace;
	font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 42px);
}
.search-preview {
	margin: 24px auto;
	max-width: 920px;
	padding: 36px;
	background: var(--search-surface);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.search-preview h1 {
	line-height: 1.3;
}
.search-preview dl {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(80px, 1fr) minmax(0, 3fr);
	gap: 12px;
}
.search-preview dd {
	margin: 0;
}
.search-preview img {
	max-width: 100%;
}
.search-preview p {
	white-space: pre-wrap;
}
@keyframes search-arrive {
	from {
		opacity: 0.6;
		transform: translateY(5px);
	}
	to {
		opacity: 1;
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
.search-page {
	animation: search-arrive 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1) both;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.search-page {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.search-family-brand {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
		gap: 20px;
	}
	.search-brand-rail {
		min-height: auto;
		padding: 20px;
	}
	.search-brand-rail strong {
		font-size: 28px;
		margin: 12px 0;
	}
	.search-brand-mark {
		display: none;
	}

	.search-family-technology .search-core {
		padding: 16px;
	}
	.search-preview {
		padding: 20px 16px;
	}
	.search-global {
		padding: 12px 16px;
	}
	.search-tabs {
		padding: 12px 16px;
	}
	.search-preview dl {
		grid-template-columns: 80px minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
	.search-page {
		animation: none;
	}
	.search-application *,
	.search-application *::before,
	.search-application *::after {
		animation-duration: 0s !important;
		transition-duration: 0s !important;
		scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	}
}

	>

<script setup>
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event) {
	setDark(event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value, type) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useSearchI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useSearchI18n();
import {
	computed,
	defineComponent,
	h,
	nextTick,
	onBeforeUnmount,
	onMounted,
	reactive,
	shallowRef,
	watch
} from 'vue';
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamConfigProvider, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createNavigation } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import { searchPages } from './Pages.js';
import { choiceModel, booleanModel } from '../cards/Models.js';
import SearchPreview from './SearchPreview.vue';
import { createSearchSession } from './Session.js';
import { createSearchService } from './Service.js';
import { emptyConditions, encodeRowKey, searchKinds, displaySearchTitle } from './Types.js';
const props = defineProps({
	confirm: { type: Function, required: false }
});
const router = useRouter(); // 借入router，不dispose。
const applicationRoot = shallowRef();
let viewRun = 0;
const access = reactive({
	identity: 'synthetic-reader',
	version: '1',
	disabled: false,
	readonly: false,
	permitted: true
});
const initialFamily =
	typeof window === 'undefined'
		? null
		: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('family');
const familyState = shallowRef(
	initialFamily === 'brand' || initialFamily === 'technology' ? initialFamily : 'minimal'
);
const family = choiceModel(
	() => familyState.value,
	(value) => {
		familyState.value = value;
	},
	['minimal', 'brand', 'technology']
);
const sizeState = shallowRef('default');
const size = choiceModel(
	() => sizeState.value,
	(value) => {
		sizeState.value = value;
	},
	['large', 'big', 'default', 'small']
);
const darkState = shallowRef(family.value === 'technology'),
	ready = shallowRef(false),
	feedback = shallowRef('');
const dark = booleanModel(
	() => darkState.value,
	(value) => {
		darkState.value = value;
	}
);
const accessReadonly = booleanModel(
	() => access.readonly,
	(value) => {
		access.readonly = value;
	}
);
const accessDisabled = booleanModel(
	() => access.disabled,
	(value) => {
		access.disabled = value;
	}
);
const accessPermitted = booleanModel(
	() => access.permitted,
	(value) => {
		access.permitted = value;
	}
);
const sizeLabel = (value) => {
	const keys = {
		large: 'app.templates.search.sizelarge',
		big: 'app.templates.search.sizebig',
		default: 'app.templates.search.sizedefault',
		small: 'app.templates.search.sizesmall'
	};
	return i18n.t(keys[value]);
};
const sizes = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const initialKind =
	typeof window === 'undefined'
		? 'basic'
		: (searchKinds.find(
				(value) => value === new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('kind')
			) ?? 'basic');
const navigation = shallowRef();
const services = Object.fromEntries(searchKinds.map((kind) => [kind, createSearchService(kind)]));
const sessions = Object.fromEntries(
	searchKinds.map((kind) => [
		kind,
		createSearchSession({
			kind,
			service: services[kind],
			access: () => access,
			accumulatePages: true
		})
	])
);

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { encodeRowKey } from './Types.js';
const categories = ['设计', '工程', 0, '0', null];
const statuses = ['已就绪', '进行中', false, null];
const owners = ['林岚', '周远', 0, '0', null, undefined];
export const localGraphic = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="280" viewBox="0 0 600 280"><rect width="600" height="280" fill="#dde8e3"/><path d="M40 240L210 40 380 240ZM260 240L430 40 570 240Z" fill="none" stroke="#46675a" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="300" cy="140" r="62" fill="#a4c3b4"/></svg>')}`;
/** 合成数据固定100条；0与'0'拥有独立typed身份。 */
export function createSearchRecords(kind) {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index) => {
		const base = {
			id: index === 1 ? '0' : index === 0 ? 0 : index,
			title:
				index === 6
					? '跨团队协作中的设计约束、工程记录与长期内容整理方法'.repeat(3)
					: `${['山海知识', '城市观察', '协作档案', '开放研究'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
			description:
				index === 6
					? '长内容用于检验窄屏换行与完整阅读。'.repeat(9)
					: '记录设计、工程与协作中的具体方法，提供可追溯的本地演示内容。',
			category: categories[index % categories.length],
			status: statuses[index % statuses.length],
			owner: owners[index % owners.length]
		};
		switch (kind) {
			case 'basic':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					reference: `REF-${index + 1}`,
					updatedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-12' : undefined
				};
			case 'cards':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					cover: {
						src: index === 3 ? './missing-cover.svg' : localGraphic,
						alt: `山海几何构图 ${index + 1}`
					},
					collection: index % 2 ? '空间研究' : '日常设计'
				};
			case 'articles':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					author: index % 2 ? '陈澄' : '许知',
					publishedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-10' : null,
					tags: ['设计方法', index % 2 ? '案例' : '实践'],
					body: [
						'从一个具体问题开始，记录观察、约束与取舍。',
						'示例正文仅为本地合成文本。<script>不会执行</script>',
						base.description
					]
				};
			case 'projects':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					stage: index % 4 ? '宿主阶段：研究验证' : undefined,
					progress: index % 4 ? (index * 7) % 101 : NaN,
					startDate: '2026-09-01',
					endDate: index % 3 ? '2026-12-01' : null,
					members: [
						{ name: '林岚', avatar: index === 2 ? './missing-avatar.svg' : undefined },
						{ name: '周远' }
					]
				};
			case 'applications':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					icon: localGraphic,
					version: index % 3 ? '2.1.0' : null,
					platforms: ['Web', '桌面浏览器'],
					available: index % 3 ? true : false,
					route: 'local-demo'
				};
		}
	});
}
export function querySearchRecords(rows, request) {
	const q = request.query;
	const keyword = typeof q.keyword === 'string' ? q.keyword.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
	const filtered = rows.filter(
		(row) =>
			(!keyword ||
				`${row.title} ${row.description} ${row.kind === 'articles' ? row.body.join(' ') : ''}`
					.toLocaleLowerCase()
					.includes(keyword)) &&
			['category', 'status', 'owner'].every(
				(key) =>
					q[key] === undefined ||
					Object.is(
						key === 'status' && row.kind === 'applications'
							? row.available
							: Reflect.get(row, key),
						q[key]
					)
			)
	);
	if (request.sort) {
		const { field, order } = request.sort;
		if (!['title', 'id'].includes(field))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('未允许的排序字段'),
				'app.templates.search.invalidSort'
			);
		filtered.sort(
			(a, b) =>
				String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
					String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
					'zh-CN',
					{ numeric: true }
				) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1) ||
				encodeRowKey(a.id).localeCompare(encodeRowKey(b.id))
		);
	}
	return {
		list: filtered.slice(
			(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
			request.currentPage * request.pageSize
		),
		total: filtered.length
	};
}
/** 这是可替换的合成读取适配，查询/排序作用于全部100条。 */
export function createSearchService(kind) {
	const rows = createSearchRecords(kind);
	let fail = false,
		calls = 0;
	return {
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		failNext() {
			fail = true;
		},
		async read(request, context) {
			calls++;
			const shouldFail = fail;
			fail = false;
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new DOMException('读取取消', 'AbortError'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 100);
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
				else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			});
			if (shouldFail)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'合成读取失败，请重试',
					'app.templates.search.readFailed'
				);
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { effectScope, toValue } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { emptyConditions } from './Types.js';
import { searchContent } from './Content.js';
export const searchFields = [
	{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text', defaultValue: () => '' },
	...['category', 'status', 'owner'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: { category: '类别', status: '状态', owner: '负责人' }[key] ?? key,
		kind: 'single',
		query: (value) => value
	}))
];
/** 自有effect scope只释放本会话创建的controller；借入runtime/controller从不dispose。 */
export function createSearchSession(options) {
	if (options.controller && !options.runtime)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('借入controller必须显式提供其宿主runtime'),
			'app.templates.search.borrowRuntime'
		);
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const runtime =
		options.runtime ??
		createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: `search:${options.kind}:${toValue(options.access).identity}`
		});
	let alive = true;
	const access = () => toValue(options.access);
	const guard = () =>
		JSON.stringify([
			runtime.scope,
			runtime.epoch,
			access().identity,
			access().version,
			access().disabled,
			access().permitted
		]);
	const current = (token) =>
		alive && !access().disabled && access().permitted && token === guard();
	const accumulatesPages = !!options.accumulatePages && !options.controller;
	const prefixes = new Map();
	const queryKey = (query) => JSON.stringify([query.query, query.sort, query.pageSize]);
	const controller =
		options.controller ??
		scope.run(() =>
			useAsamListController({
				fields: searchFields,
				initial: { ...emptyConditions },
				pageSize: 20,
				immediate: false,
				rowKey: (row) => row.id,
				runtime,
				api: async (request, context) => {
					const token = guard();
					if (!current(token))
						throw createAsamMessageError(
							'当前身份、权限或禁用状态不允许读取',
							'app.templates.search.readDenied'
						);
					let prefix = [];
					if (accumulatesPages) {
						const previous = controller.successfulSource.value;
						if (request.currentPage === 1) prefixes.clear();
						else if (
							previous?.epoch === runtime.epoch &&
							queryKey(previous) === queryKey(request)
						) {
							if (previous.currentPage + 1 === request.currentPage) {
								prefix = controller.page.data.value.list;
								prefixes.set(request.currentPage, prefix);
							} else if (previous.currentPage >= request.currentPage) {
								prefix = prefixes.get(request.currentPage) ?? [];
							}
						}
					}
					const result = await options.service.read(request, context);
					context.signal.throwIfAborted();
					if (!current(token)) throw new DOMException('读取上下文已失效', 'AbortError');
					if (!accumulatesPages || !result.total) return result;
					const records = new Map(
						[...prefix, ...result.list].map((row) => [row.id, row])
					);
					return {
						list: [...records.values()].slice(0, result.total),
						total: result.total
					};
				}
			})
		);
	return {
		kind: options.kind,
		accumulatesPages,
		controller,
		runtime,
		content: searchContent,
		access,
		guard,
		current,
		async read(operation) {
			const token = guard();
			if (!current(token)) return false;
			await operation();
			return current(token);
		},
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			scope.stop();
		}
	};
}

export const searchKinds = ['basic', 'cards', 'articles', 'projects', 'applications'];
export const searchTitles = {
	basic: '资料列表',
	cards: '灵感卡片',
	articles: '文章搜索',
	projects: '项目搜索',
	applications: '应用搜索'
};
export const emptyConditions = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined
};
export function encodeRowKey(key) {
	return `${typeof key}:${String(key)}`;
}
export function displaySearchTitle(kind, scope) {
	const keys = {
		basic: 'app.templates.search.titleBasic',
		cards: 'app.templates.search.titleCards',
		articles: 'app.templates.search.titleArticles',
		projects: 'app.templates.search.titleProjects',
		applications: 'app.templates.search.titleApplications'
	};
	return scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t(keys[kind]) : searchTitles[kind];
}

js
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Bottom, Refresh, Sort, Top } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const modes = [
	{ sort: null, label: 'defaultSort', icon: Sort },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'ascending' }, label: 'titleAsc', icon: Top },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'descending' }, label: 'titleDesc', icon: Bottom }
];
export function useSearchListTools(
	session,
	sortLabel,
	refreshLabel,
	{ refreshFromStart = false } = {}
) {
	const c = session.controller;
	const canQuery = computed(() => {
		const access = session.access();
		return access.permitted && !access.disabled && c.scopeReady.value;
	});
	const canRead = computed(() => canQuery.value && !c.page.loading.value);
	const sortIndex = computed(() => {
		const sort = c.intent.value?.sort;
		return Math.max(
			0,
			modes.findIndex(
				({ sort: mode }) => mode?.field === sort?.field && mode?.order === sort?.order
			)
		);
	});
	const tools = computed(() => {
		const mode = modes[sortIndex.value] ?? modes[0];
		return [
			{
				id: 'sort',
				label: sortLabel(mode.label),
				icon: mode.icon,
				disabled: !canQuery.value || !c.intent.value,
				ariaDisabled: canQuery.value && !canRead.value,
				pressed: sortIndex.value !== 0,
				state: sortIndex.value === 0 ? 'default-sort' : undefined
			},
			{ id: 'refresh', label: refreshLabel(), icon: Refresh, disabled: !canRead.value }
		];
	});
	function run(id) {
		if (!canRead.value) return;
		if (id === 'sort' && c.intent.value) {
			const next = modes[(sortIndex.value + 1) % modes.length] ?? modes[0];
			void session.read(() => c.setSort(next.sort));
		}
		if (id === 'refresh') {
			const intent = c.intent.value;
			void session.read(() =>
				refreshFromStart && intent && intent.currentPage > 1
					? c.setSort(intent.sort)
					: c.refresh()
			);
		}
	}
	return { tools, run };
}

	background: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);

				:size="size"
				:icon="Plus"
				:disabled="createDisabled"
				@click="emit('create')"
				>{{ createLabel }}</AsamButton
			><span v-if="summary" class="template-list-toolbar-summary" role="status">{{
				summary
			}}</span>
		</div>
		<div v-if="actions.length" class="template-list-toolbar-tools">
			<AsamButton
				v-for="tool in actions"
				:key="tool.id"
				class="template-list-toolbar-icon"
				type="primary"
				:text="!tool.pressed"
				:size="size"
				:icon="tool.icon"
				:disabled="tool.disabled"
				:aria-disabled="tool.ariaDisabled || undefined"
				:aria-pressed="tool.pressed"
				:aria-label="tool.label"
				:title="tool.label"
				:data-state="tool.state"
				@click="activate(tool)"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const props = defineProps({
	label: { type: String, required: true },
	summary: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	createLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	createDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	tools: { type: Array, required: false },
	viewDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	wide: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: undefined },
	layout: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['create', 'action', 'update:wide', 'update:layout']);
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.template-list-toolbar,
.template-list-toolbar-start,
.template-list-toolbar-tools {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.template-list-toolbar {
	width: 100%;
	justify-content: space-between;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	padding: 16px 20px;
	background: var(--asam-color-surface);
}

.template-list-toolbar-tools {
	margin-inline-start: auto;
	gap: var(--asam-operations-tools-gap, 4px);
}

.template-list-toolbar-icon {
	margin-inline-start: 0;
	padding-inline: var(--asam-space-2, 8px);
}

.template-list-toolbar-icon[data-state='default-sort'] :deep(svg) {
	transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.template-list-toolbar-summary {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-regular);
	font-size: var(--asam-typography-font-size-sm, 13px);
}
</style>
